gloss: to approach; to draw near; to get close

definitions.gloss: to approach; to draw near physically
definitions.explanation: To move closer to something or someone in physical space, or for something to come nearer.

definitions.gloss: to become closer; to grow intimate
definitions.explanation: To develop a closer relationship or to bring positions closer together in negotiations or opinions.

examples.japanese: ⟦{台風|たいふう}→台風：01455_taifuu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{接近|せっきん}して⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
⟦{不審者|ふしんしゃ}→不審者：11348_fushinsha⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{学校|がっこう}→学校：00055_gakkou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{接近|せっきん}した。
examples.english: A suspicious person approached the school.

examples.japanese: ⟦{小惑星|しょうわくせい}→小惑星：05244_shouwakusei⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{地球|ちきゅう}→地球：03461_chikyuu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{最|もっと}も→最も：01736_mottomo⟧{接近|せっきん}する⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{来月|らいげつ}→来月：00744_raigetsu⟧だ。
examples.english: The asteroid will make its closest approach to Earth next month.

examples.japanese: ⟦{両国|りょうこく}→両国：10010_ryoukoku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{立場|たちば}→立場：03403_tachiba⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{接近|せっきん}した。
examples.english: The positions of the two countries drew closer.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{接近|せっきん}しようとした⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦{警戒|けいかい}→警戒：14224_keikai⟧⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。

examples.japanese: ⟦{交渉|こうしょう}→交渉：02727_koushou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{重|かさ}ねる→重ねる：02039_kasaneru⟧うち⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧、⟦お{互|たが}い→お互い：00336_otagai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{意見|いけん}→意見：01303_iken⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{接近|せっきん}してきた。
examples.english: As negotiations continued, their opinions gradually drew closer together.

notes:
Frequently used in weather reports (typhoons approaching) and news. In the figurative sense, it describes people or positions moving closer together. Has a somewhat formal or objective tone.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{台風|たいふう}→台風：01455_taifuu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{接近|せっきん}する: a typhoon approaches
- ⟦{最|さい}→最〜：03954_sai⟧⟦{接近|せっきん}→接近：04365_sekkin⟧: closest approach
- ⟦{異常|いじょう}→異常：01716_ijou⟧⟦{接近|せっきん}→接近：04365_sekkin⟧: abnormally close approach; near-miss
- ⟦{接近|せっきん}→接近：04365_sekkin⟧⟦{禁止|きんし}→禁止：02643_kinshi⟧: no-approach order; restraining order
- ⟦{接近戦|せっきんせん}→接近戦：15575_sekkinsen⟧: close combat

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{近|ちか}づく→近づく：01958_chikazuku⟧: to approach, to get close — more everyday and casual
- ⟦{迫|せま}る→迫る：03928_semaru⟧: to draw near, to press — adds urgency or pressure
- ⟦{寄|よ}る→寄る：02440_yoru⟧: to go near, to drop by — casual, implies a brief visit or slight movement toward
